hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Topstep auto-flattens at 16:08 ET and MFFU requires flat by 16:10 ET; positions still open at the deadline are disproportionately on the losing side of the day (disposition effect), so the forced flow extends the day's RTH move 16:00->16:10 and the extension reverts once the flow stops (own idea, candidates.md rank 85, IG C-12-01). Sign fixed: after an extension in the direction of the day's move, FADE it 16:10->16:14 from a later-deadline account.
rules: Data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1m, stype_in=continuous, <ROOT>.v.0, bought 2026-11-09 by batch job AFTER this registration (estimate row first); ingested to DATA_ROOT/derived/<dataset>.parquet, ts = bar OPEN in UTC, columns open/high/low/close/volume/instrument_id; rows >= 2025-01-01 only to DATA_ROOT/holdout/. Times are America/New_York via zoneinfo. P(HH:MM) = CLOSE of the bar opening HH:MM-1min (last trade before HH:MM:00); if that bar is missing, the latest earlier bar within 5 minutes with the same instrument_id, else the observation is ineligible (counted). Any return uses two prices with the same instrument_id (roll rule ex ante). Trading days = full XNYS sessions (exchange_calendars), early closes skipped. EWMA sigma = sqrt(EWMA, centre of mass 60, of the squared signal over the instrument's prior eligible days through d-1), at least 40 prior observations (IS warm-up read first). D(d) = ln(P(16:00)/OPEN of the bar opening 09:30 ET) on ES (the RTH day move). X(d) = ln(P(16:10)/P(16:00)). Trade on d iff sign(X) = sign(D) and |X| > 0.5 x EWMA sigma of X. Position = -sign(D), one ES contract. ENTRY at the OPEN of the bar opening 16:10 ET; EXIT at the CLOSE of the bar opening 16:13 ET (last trade before 16:14:00, before the 16:15 halt). Per-event net bp as in Q-0017.
parameters: extension window 16:00->16:10; threshold 0.5 sigma; entry 16:10 open; exit 16:13 close (4 min); neighbours (fixed now): threshold 0.375 and 0.625 sigma; exit at the CLOSE of the 16:12 bar and of the 16:14 bar (hold 3 / 5 min); EWMA com 45 and 75; one-bar-delay = entry at the OPEN of the 16:11 bar; volatility terciles as Q-0017 (IS bounds). Information only: MES share of 16:05-16:09 volume vs its prior-20-day median (footprint), and the subset where the share is above median.
instruments: CME ES (traded from a Lucid/Tradeify 16:45 ET or Bulenox 16:59 ET account; MES footprint data)
vol_scaler: none: one ES contract per event
cost_model: per side ES 0.50 pt x $50 + $2.50 (post-close book), entry and exit; 2x run doubles.
notes: post-change: institutional change dates 2019-05-06 (MES launch, the footprint data) and ~2021-2023 (prop-firm crowd growth); OOS 2022-2024 is the post-change window. The prop-firm crowd only became large after ~2021 (Topstep bots since 2023, MFFU founded 2023), so OOS is 3.0 years by construction: bar 2.12 annual Sharpe on the per-event series; criterion-4 power ~0.1 at true Sharpe 1.5 and ~0.4 at 2.4 - LOW POWER, registered under D-020 because the count costs no strictness. MES starts 2019-05-06. Closed relatives: none inside; adjacent to Q-0017 (same minutes, different trigger and window) - the two rows are counted separately and both reported.
owner: Director (main session 2026-11-09, D-028); Pre-registration Officer: Director
data_sha256: PINNED AT INGEST (data bought after this registration): sha256 of each derived parquet written to data/manifest.csv before the first gateway read; the result file prints manifest = recomputed
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, exactly one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run (IS read for warm-up first): pass iff (1) the deciding one-sided t (minimum of iid, Newey-West lag 10 and the ET-date-clustered t of the net-1x per-event series) >= 3.6807 AND the stationary-bootstrap (>= 430,000 draws) one-sided lower bound at alpha 0.05/430 > 0; (2) net-2x mean > 0; (3) PARAMETERS.md criteria 4 and 7: >= 70% of OOS calendar years positive, no single year > 50% of a positive net, >= 2 of 3 IS-bounded volatility terciles positive, every +-25% neighbour in parameters net-positive, the one-bar-delay variant net-positive; (4) Red Team / re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Mechanical verdict: PASS Gate 3 if (1)-(3); NEAR-MISS if deciding t >= 2.6807 with bootstrap 5th percentile of the mean > 0; else FAIL. Before the OOS read, on IS only: truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry instant; decision unchanged), perturbation harness (1% noise on post-entry bars) on >= 30 sampled IS events, and a planted look-ahead must fail. The result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length.
